🎮 PlayStation Plus just revealed its December 2026 Essential lineup — a nostalgia-packed trio!

Starting December 1, PS Plus Essential subscribers can claim:
🏚️ Amnesia: The Bunker (PS4)
🐉 Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 (PS5, PS4)
🛹 Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 (PS5, PS4)

All three join the service free for Essential members, alongside the previously-announced PS Plus Extra/Premium Game Catalog additions like Assassin's Creed Mirage and Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty.

🕒 Announced: Nov 25, 2026, 7:32 PM (GMT+3)

📰 Sources: PlayStation Blog, Gematsu

👥 x.com/PlayStation

Which one are you downloading first on December 1? Let us know below! 👇
